events.title: The Nutcracker (Opus Performing Arts with the Bellingham Symphony Orchestra)
events.blurb: Opus Performing Arts dances Tchaikovsky's ballet with more than 130 dancers, and the Bellingham Symphony Orchestra plays live under Yaniv Attar.
events.blurbEs: Opus Performing Arts presenta el ballet de Chaikovski con más de 130 bailarines y la Bellingham Symphony Orchestra en vivo, dirigida por Yaniv Attar.

events.title: Seattle International Comedy Competition Finals
events.blurb: Five finalists compete in the 46th annual competition's finals, the audience helps pick the winner, and Julia Hladkowicz hosts. The theatre labels the show for mature audiences.
events.blurbEs: Cinco finalistas compiten en la final de la 46.ª edición, el público ayuda a elegir al ganador y Julia Hladkowicz es la presentadora. El teatro indica que el show es para público adulto.

events.title: Allen Fitzpatrick in A Christmas Carol
events.blurb: Actor Allen Fitzpatrick performs Dickens' A Christmas Carol in Fairhaven.
events.blurbEs: El actor Allen Fitzpatrick interpreta A Christmas Carol de Dickens en Fairhaven.

events.title: Shop Small Saturday
events.blurb: Downtown Bellingham's boutiques, shops and galleries mark Small Business Saturday, and holiday window displays go up starting Thanksgiving weekend.
events.blurbEs: Las boutiques, tiendas y galerías del centro de Bellingham celebran el Small Business Saturday, y los escaparates navideños se estrenan el fin de semana de Acción de Gracias.

events.title: Fairhaven Winterfest
events.blurb: A late-afternoon Winterfest gathering in the Historic Fairhaven Village.
events.blurbEs: Un encuentro de Winterfest al final de la tarde en Historic Fairhaven Village.

events.title: Bellingham Farmers Market: Saturday Market
events.blurb: The Saturday farmers market sets up at Depot Market Square downtown.
events.blurbEs: El mercado de agricultores de los sábados se instala en Depot Market Square, en el centro.

events.title: MegaZapper Electrical Show
events.blurb: An afternoon electricity show at the SPARK Museum of Electrical Invention downtown.
events.blurbEs: Un espectáculo de electricidad por la tarde en el SPARK Museum of Electrical Invention, en el centro.

events.title: Blaine Holiday Harbor Lights
events.blurb: Blaine's holiday celebration in its downtown, about 20 miles north of Bellingham.
events.blurbEs: La celebración navideña de Blaine en su centro, a unas 20 millas al norte de Bellingham.

events.title: Laughs at Larrabee Comedy Night Starring Billie Manton
events.blurb: Billie Manton headlines a comedy night at Larrabee Lager Company.
events.blurbEs: Billie Manton encabeza una noche de comedia en Larrabee Lager Company.

events.title: Live Music at Stones Throw Brewery
events.blurb: Early-evening live music at Stones Throw Brewery in Fairhaven.
events.blurbEs: Música en vivo al caer la tarde en Stones Throw Brewery, en Fairhaven.
